page: Microsoft Azure EC64es_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEV5 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The virtualization layer is managed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external volumes. It is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance remote disk options. The instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density relative to the dedicated CPU allocation provides a specialized resource profile designed to handle memory-bound workloads without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given the 512.0 GB memory capacity and 64 dedicated vCPUs, the EC64es_v5 is engineered for memory-intensive enterprise applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data analytics pipelines that require substantial RAM but do not require local scratch disks.
